diagnosis.finding: The c1b action probe omitted top_k, min_p, and reasoning_effort and capped max_tokens at 256, while the live evaluator passed top_k=20, min_p=0, reasoning_effort=high, and max_tokens=4096 through the typed action request.

same_bank_replay.live_failure_mode: Most non-local decisions collapsed to solve_owned.

decision: Reject c1n without relaxing any gate. Normalize only the split action request to the already validated c1b sampling boundary, keep the isolated c1l request unchanged, and replace hidden exact-expert admission with a fresh prospective end-to-end causal-utility bank.
